findings.title: The macOS application firewall is disabled
findings.impact: Every listening service on this machine accepts inbound connections without a per-application decision, so a background agent that opens a port is reachable by default.

remediation.caveat: This is a per-application filter, not a packet filter; it does not replace a network firewall.

findings.title: Software updates are pending
findings.impact: Published fixes, including security fixes, are available but not installed. How serious that is depends on which packages are behind.

remediation.summary: Review the pending updates and apply them with the host's package manager.
commands: # review the list first, then apply with apt / dnf / zypper / softwareupdate
remediation.caveat: Some updates need a restart to take effect; schedule accordingly.
